officersNote: The governor and lieutenant governor are the only officers Alaska's voters elect statewide; the attorney general and the other commissioners are appointed by the governor.

officers.unnamed: The Lieutenant Governor's own website could not be read when this list was built, because its security certificate is incomplete, so no name is shown until it can be.
officers.note: ltgov.alaska.gov sends its own certificate twice and no intermediate certificate (measured 2026-11-12 with openssl s_client), so no client that checks certificates can read it, and the other Alaska state pages tried (www.alaska.gov, the Division of Elections) either closed the connection or have the same fault.
